goals.title: Program foundation
goals.description: Create the team structure, documentation habits, safety culture, budget ownership, and review cadence needed for a multi-year program.

goals.title: Define SpaceShot mission requirements
goals.description: Agree on the mission-level definition of success, constraints, responsibilities, and evidence required at each major review.

goals.title: Build multi-year funding & sponsorship plan
goals.description: Create a realistic funding model, sponsor pipeline, purchasing process, and reserve strategy for testing and launch operations.

goals.title: Establish member training pathway
goals.description: Create repeatable onboarding and subsystem training so knowledge survives leadership turnover and new members can contribute quickly.

goals.title: Mature liquid propulsion workstream
goals.description: Progress through design reviews and increasingly integrated tests while maintaining clear test readiness and safety gates.

goals.title: Complete propulsion preliminary design review
goals.description: Document architecture, interfaces, risks, verification approach, and open decisions for club review.

goals.title: Establish propulsion test-readiness process
goals.description: Standardize pre-test checklists, hazard review, instrumentation readiness, data ownership, and post-test review practices.

goals.title: Develop flight structures & recovery
goals.description: Advance airframe, interfaces, recovery architecture, manufacturability, and inspection practices toward an integrated flight vehicle.

goals.title: Complete structures preliminary design review
goals.description: Baseline structural concepts, interfaces, loads assumptions, fabrication approach, and verification plan.

goals.title: Develop avionics & telemetry platform
goals.description: Build a maintainable flight-computing, sensing, telemetry, and ground-data workflow with staged verification.

goals.title: Validate avionics prototype stack
goals.description: Demonstrate the core sensing, logging, telemetry, and recovery-control workflow in representative tests.

goals.title: Develop ground systems & operations
goals.description: Create the tooling, procedures, roles, communications, and site-readiness practices required to support integrated testing and flight operations.

goals.title: Integrated vehicle campaign
goals.description: Bring the major workstreams together through formal integration reviews, rehearsals, and progressive vehicle-level validation.

goals.title: Complete critical design review
goals.description: Freeze the primary vehicle configuration and confirm interfaces, risks, verification plans, ownership, and remaining work.

goals.title: Complete full-system integration rehearsal
goals.description: Run an end-to-end team rehearsal covering vehicle, ground systems, data flow, procedures, communications, and decision gates.

goals.title: Flight-test campaign
goals.description: Use progressive flight opportunities to validate operations, recovery, avionics, interfaces, team execution, and post-flight review practices.

goals.title: Complete mission dress rehearsal
goals.description: Execute the complete launch-day process with the final team structure, checklists, communications, and go/no-go criteria.

goals.title: SpaceShot readiness review
goals.description: Close mission-critical actions and confirm vehicle, team, site, documentation, logistics, and contingency readiness.
